title: Zayin Hebrew Letter (ז): Sound & Words
description: Learn the Hebrew letter Zayin (ז): its [z] sound, with example words like זְבוּב (fly) and זֶה (this), plus interactive practice.

editorialIssues.detail: One letter-recognition distractor set uses letters (Resh, Nun) not introduced in this lesson. Beginner scaffolding can be improved separately from the approved source synchronization.

blocks.0: Zayin Hebrew Letter (ז): Sound, Words & Practice

theory.heading: Meet Zayin
theory.intro: The seventh letter of the Hebrew alphabet. Zayin makes a [z] sound, as in “zoo.”
objectives: Read Zayin in real words like <bdi class="hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl">זְבוּב</bdi> (fly).

examples.heading: Zayin in real words
examples.intro: See Zayin in two new Hebrew words and a phrase, and review the Segol, Shuruk, Patah and Kamatz Gadol vowel marks from earlier letters.
